metadata.site_title: Yalla Sport | Live football scores, leagues, and verified news
metadata.site_description: Yalla Sport is an Arabic-first football desk for live scores, league tables, kickoff times, and source-verified news. Follow the Premier League, La Liga, the Champions League, and the Egyptian Premier League with real figures — never invented results.

about.title: About us
about.headline: An Arabic football platform built on real figures and approved news.
about.standfirst: Yalla Sport brings scores, kickoff times, news and licensed streams into one clear place. What appears on the page is what stands at the desk — no invented numbers, no empty promises.
about.rules_kicker: Four clauses that guide every page
about.rule_1_body: Kickoff, score and table come from the sports source. If they have not arrived yet, the cell stays empty until they do.
about.rule_2_body: A story reaches readers after editorial review. No headline without a source, and no briefing written only to fill space.
about.rule_3_body: The watch room opens on a licensed asset only. If none is available, no dummy Watch button appears.
about.rule_4_body: Sign-in is Google for now. No forms that promise work they cannot do, and no recovery mail we pretend has left.
about.flow_kicker: Three stations from source to reader
about.flow_1_body: Figures and times as received from the sports source, with no dressing layer over a gap.
about.flow_2_body: The report is reviewed and approved before publication. Unapproved copy does not reach readers.
about.flow_3_body: The reader sees only what stands. Empty stays empty until a real figure or report arrives.
about.door_matches_hint: Today’s programme, and the score if it arrived.
about.door_watch_hint: A library of licensed assets when available.
about.letter_body: For enquiries, privacy or copyright notices. Write from the contact page or email the desk directly.
about.quote: Empty stays empty until it arrives. Clarity beats decoration.
about.desk_note: Live figures from the desk database at this moment — including live matches when any are running.
about.desk_empty: No live matches are on file right now. The tallies above stay open for follow-up.
about.pillars_note: Four principles that run through every wing: coverage, figures, accounts, and copy.
about.wings_kicker: How each wing of the site works
about.wing_1_body: Matches, leagues and tables as received. Search and comparison open the same ledger — no invented ranking.
about.wing_2_body: A report goes live after approval, and in the language you choose if an approved translation exists. Arabic is the house tongue; English is a second door in the header.
about.wing_3_body: Broadcasts, the channel guide, and watch. A channel is named if it is on file; the player runs on a licensed asset only.
about.wing_4_body: Sign-in is Google. The predictions board counts recorded points. Serious letters reach the desk mailbox.
about.langs_title: Arabic first, English from the door
about.langs_body: The site is written from the right. English is not decoration laid over Arabic; the language key in the header turns the whole page.
about.absence_title: What you will not find here
about.absence_1: A score that did not arrive from the source
about.absence_3: A Watch button on an unlicensed file
about.absence_4: A form that says a message left when it did not
about.absence_5: An invented follower count or coverage boast
about.rooms_kicker: A map of real doors inside the site
about.door_leagues_hint: A directory by country, and a table if it exists.
about.door_live_hint: Live from the pitch when available.
about.door_board_hint: A ranking of recorded points only.
about.door_search_hint: An index of names as filed.
about.door_compare_hint: Two pans from the ledger for a clear matchup.
about.door_contact_hint: A letter stored in the desk inbox.
about.colo_print: Set in the digital desk · Yalla Sport
about.coverage_desc: Leagues and matches recorded at the desk, with tables when they exist.
about.accuracy_desc: No invented scores in the copy; an empty cell is clearer than a fake number.
about.community_desc: Google sign-in is stored at the desk for predictions and personal features.
about.quality_desc: A report goes live only after approval, in two languages when a translation exists.
about.intro: An Arabic football desk: scores from the source, approved news, and licensed broadcasts when they exist.
about.vision_text: A clear pitch for scores, kickoff times and approved news — from the first whistle to the last, without noise covering the field.
about.mission_text: No stream without a licence, no report without a source, and no form that promises what the site cannot do. Clarity is part of the product.

board.title: Predictions board
board.headline: Points as they were stored. No podium invented over zero.
board.standfirst: These are accounts that wrote a prediction on a match at the desk. Rank is by stored points, then by number of slips. If scoring has not run, the balance stays zero.
board.quote: A prediction is a pastime inside the account. It is not a bet, not a cash prize, and not a name drawn for show.
board.tally_note: Figures from the desk database. Zero is zero.
board.rule_1_body: A prediction opens on a fixture the desk holds. No slip on a kickoff that was not recorded.
board.rule_2_body: Home win, draw, or away win. One slip per match; the last choice is kept.
board.rule_3_body: Without sign-in, no slip is written. The name on the board is the account name, or “No name”.
board.rule_4_body: The balance is read from the account. The engine that marks a slip after full time is not running yet, so we do not promise fifty points and we do not fill a podium.
board.empty_body: No slips are saved yet. The podium is drawn after the first signed-in prediction.
board.place_none: You are signed in, with no slip yet. A rank appears after the first prediction.
board.absence_1: A generated avatar or a crown title
board.absence_2: Points promised in copy but not written to the account
board.absence_3: A cash prize or an invitation to gamble
board.colo: Set from the accounts ledger. No second impression over the balance.
board.prog_title: Fixtures you can write a slip on
board.prog_note: A match that has not kicked off yet at the desk. The link opens the match page. No score is shown here before the whistle.
board.prog_empty: No fixture is open for a prediction in the ledger right now.
board.door_home_hint: The home side in the prediction.
board.door_away_hint: The away side in the prediction.
board.path_title: From the door to the ledger
board.path_1_body: Without an account, no slip is saved.
board.path_2_body: A prediction only on a recorded fixture.
board.path_3_body: The last door you press is the one kept.
board.path_4_body: Your name appears after the first slip. Points after the marking engine.
board.engine_body: The slip is saved now. Matching the result and awarding the balance are not wired to full time yet. Settled slips stay at zero, and no podium is drawn over a zero balance.
board.mood_note: A count of recorded choices, not an invented poll.

seek.title: Search
seek.headline: Search the ledger as it is written.
seek.standfirst: Teams, players, leagues, fixtures, and approved news. Suggestions come from the same record.
seek.quote: Search is a written request on a slip. Not an invented trend, and not a checkbox that filters nothing.
seek.ticket_title: What are you asking the index?
seek.ticket_note: Eighty characters. A quick suggestion after two letters, from stored names only.
seek.placeholder: A team, player, league, or news title…
seek.no_suggest: No quick suggestion for “{q}”. Press to search fully.
seek.catalog_note: Results from the desk database for this phrase.
seek.empty_body: Try a team, player, or league name as it appears on the site.
seek.empty_drawer: This filter is empty for that phrase.
seek.drawers_note: Live counts from the database now. Write a name to open results.
seek.drawer_news_body: A published title or body, including an approved translation for this language.
seek.drawer_teams_body: The name as filed on the team card.
seek.drawer_players_body: Player names as stored in the ledger.
seek.drawer_leagues_body: The league name as kept in the competitions ledger.
seek.drawer_matches_body: A match whose home, away, or league name matches the request.
seek.rule_1_body: Search matches the name as it is stored.
seek.rule_2_body: Only approved news enters the index.
seek.rule_3_body: A match score appears only if it is stored in the record.
seek.rule_4_body: Filters are links that actually change the results.
seek.absence_1: A trend or hot suggestion with no source in the ledger
seek.absence_2: Filter boxes that do not change results
seek.absence_3: Decorative pictures where no crest or photo is stored
seek.absence_4: A match score that has not been written yet
seek.doors_title: If you want to browse without a slip

post.title: Contact
post.headline: Write to the desk. The message is saved and a reference appears.
post.standfirst: You write here. The message is stored in the desk inbox, and a copy goes to the site email when mail is on.
post.quote: A letter is paper. If it arrives, a ledger reference appears. If site mail is off, it stays in the inbox — we do not pretend it flew.
post.addr_note: This is the site email. You can also write from the form on this page.
post.letter_title: Write as you would a letter
post.letter_note: Choose a subject and write clearly. Page URL and reply email are optional.
post.signed_note: You are signed in with Google. The reply field is filled from that account; you may change it before sending.
post.field_body_ph: Write clearly. A letter without enough detail may be set aside.
post.err_rate: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
post.err_save: Could not save the message. Check the fields and try again.
post.receipt_mailed: Saved in the desk inbox, with a copy sent to {mail}.
post.receipt_mail_fail: Saved in the desk inbox. The mail copy could not be sent.
post.path_1_body: You write the message on this page.
post.path_2_body: On send, a record is created in the desk inbox.
post.path_3_body: A copy is sent to the site email when mail is available.
post.path_4_body: A reference number appears after the save.
post.wings_note: Choose a subject. Content reports have their own page.
post.wing_1_body: A question about the site, press, or partnership — written as it is.
post.wing_2_body: An account or data matter. Details stay in the inbox.
post.wing_3_body: A mark or text you believe is shown without right. A page URL helps.
post.wing_4_body: A score, story, or stream fault is filed from the report page.
post.absence_1: A phone or WhatsApp number we have not published
post.absence_2: A map or street address we invented
post.absence_3: Decorative social accounts without real links
post.absence_4: A one-hour reply promise or a fake ticket
post.doors_title: If the letter is of another kind
post.colo: Printed from the correspondence room. No second copy over a letter that was not saved.

versus.title: Team comparison
versus.headline: Two pans. No winner is crowned from a number that was not played.
versus.standfirst: Seat two teams from the ledger. What follows is a count of stored finished matches, not a forecast or a radar.
versus.standfirst_pair: The figures come from finished matches on the desk. Head-to-head is separate from all-time games.
versus.quote: The scale weighs what is placed on it. If a meeting was not stored, the pan stays empty — we do not fill it with a legend.
versus.pair_note: {n} teams in the ledger. Type two letters of the name as filed.
versus.type_hint: At least two letters of the stored name.
versus.same: A team is not weighed against itself.
versus.missing: One of the names is not in the ledger.
versus.scale_title: What was placed on the pans
versus.scale_note: Squad: players with no end date. Matches and goals: every finished game on the desk, not one season unless named. Head-to-head wins: finished meetings with a stored score only.
versus.skipped: {n} meetings with no stored score, left out of the wins.
versus.last_none: No finished match stored for this team.
versus.shared_note: Competitions where both teams appear together in stored league tables, if any.
versus.shared_empty: No shared competition in the stored standings.
versus.meet_note: Eight at most. The score if it exists in the record. The link opens the match page.
versus.meet_empty: No finished head-to-head between these two teams on the desk.
versus.rule_1_body: A name that is not stored does not sit. The choice is from team cards as they are.
versus.rule_2_body: Head-to-head is counted after full time in the record. A live match does not enter the wins.
versus.rule_3_title: The score if it was written
versus.rule_3_body: A finished match without two stored scores is neither a win nor a draw. We name that count if it exists.
versus.rule_4_body: Goal totals are from every finished match on the desk. Not a league table unless you open the competition page.
versus.absence_1: An invented radar or player rating
versus.absence_2: Crowning a winner from an unstored figure
versus.absence_3: A squad comparison without names from the ledger
versus.absence_4: A season or league claimed for figures without a filter
versus.doors_title: If you want a team from another room
versus.colo: Printed from the scale. No second pan over a team that did not sit.
